name: Customs House, Brisbane
scope: The extant 1889 Brisbane Customs House exterior, including the mapped apsidal Long Room, copper dome and lantern, Queen Street stone portico, and the lower masonry level on the Brisbane River side.
era: Extant 1889 Customs House at Petrie Bight, including the restored 2024 copper roof form

references.filename: Custom House and Garden Reach, Brisbane, Australia.jpg
references.caption: Customs House dominates the photograph including the copper dome. The view shows a variety of transportation including horsedrawn carts, horsedrawn buses and a brisbane tram. To the left of the postcard is the Adelaide Steamship Company's wharf.
references.alt: Customs House dominates the photograph including the copper dome. The view shows a variety of transportation including horsedrawn carts, horsedrawn buses and a brisbane tram. To the left of the postcard is the Adelaide Steamship Company's wharf.

originalReview.notes: The public-domain State Library of Queensland postcard shows the ribbed copper dome, external round drum and round northeast end, Queen Street classical pilasters and portico, and sloping river approach. The old street and wharves are outside model scope.
